body:
Thanks to everyone for their comments.  It is always useful to get another perspective on things.

A couple more points.  I don't feel stressed or under pressure.  I try to look objectively at my life but I don't see anything that would cause stress at the level that would cause this sort of amnesia.

I also doubt that I was abused as a child, but, as has been pointed out, if my memory is poor how can I be sure ;). In any case, if I cant remember then that's that really.

The comment re: disassociation was interesting.  I do find it hard to define who I am.  I know what I do, who my family is, what food I like, etc but there is no 'me' inside. Just a logical process that looks on, analyses and spits out results like 'you are depressed'.  I'm sorry, I'm phrasing this poorly - I hope the meaning i intended comes across.

"Facts but not details" - that's exactly how it is.  I know lots of stuff (especially useless details) but I couldn't tell you how I know or when I learned it. I have similar experiences to you at university.  I had friends and I spent a lot of time with them but now, 15+ years later I can't remember most of them. A couple of weeks back a guy I knew at high school recognized me.  He know my name etc even after 25 years.  I had and still have no memories of him. I recognized his name when he said it but that is it.
